summary: Checked all 12 estimates against the complete 105829-character markdown and the cited PDF pages, including scoring, assignment, sample counts, outcome phases, arms, and exclusions. The supplied PDF has 17 pages, ends with references, and contains no appendix or embedded supplement. All recorded statistical values and the main/immediate people and dyad counts match the paper and belong to the stated outcomes and arms. All 11 mechanical quote alerts are false positives: eight resolve after removing discretionary line-break hyphenation; the remaining three contain math labels that extract as replacement characters, and were confirmed on rendered PDF pages 8 and 9. Two se_basis codes incorrectly use the absence-of-uncertainty category for reported U/p tests with an unresolved inferential basis. The remaining requested coding is consistent with the paper. Retention analysis counts remain appropriately null because the individual procedure and figure dyad labels conflict. Figure-only arm means are appropriately untranscribed; Table 5 entered-answer process counts are not the main-test scored fluency means. No additional eligible outcome or full-sample contrast was found: the four AUT dimensions at three phases are covered, while the AI-only pre-study, subgroups, self-reports, process measures, and within-AI correlations are correctly excluded. The separately referenced supplement was not supplied and is outside this verification.
